title: Fraud Analyst
summary: Fraud analysts watch payments and accounts for fraud, tune the rules that stop it, and investigate flagged cases. They sit in the risk team of a bank, payments company or online marketplace, working with operations, product and partner banks.
dailyDuties: Review fraud alerts and decide to block or release accounts
Tune fraud rules and check how many good customers they stop
Pull transaction data with SQL to trace new fraud patterns
Handle chargebacks and disputes with banks and merchants
Update fraud loss and alert dashboards
Share fraud trends with product and operations teams

skills.expectation: Write, test and tune fraud rules in a monitoring tool, using device, velocity and behaviour signals, to cut losses without blocking good customers
Review fraud alerts and flagged accounts, decide to block or release, and record each case
Handle chargebacks and payment disputes under card network and UPI rules and recover losses
Understand how UPI, card, wallet and net banking payments flow between customer, merchant and bank
Write SQL to pull transactions and trace fraud patterns across tables
Analyse alert, case and loss data in Excel
Write clear case notes and explain fraud trends to product and operations teams
Work with partner banks, cyber cells and merchants to close cases
Build fraud loss and alert dashboards for leads and partner teams
Automate pattern checks and data pulls with scripts
Measure rule hit rates, false positives and loss rates
Know where fraud work ends and AML alert work begins
Check KYC documents when reviewing risky accounts
Support fraud reporting to RBI and the card networks

certifications.why: Shows SQL and dashboard basics for people moving into fraud analytics
